implementationPlan.description: Create dashboard/src/pages/WorkflowCreatePage.tsx: Route /workflows/new. Contains WorkflowBuilder in create mode (no existing workflow loaded). Save triggers useCreateWorkflow() mutation, navigates to /workflows/:newId on success. Also supports import: toggle to JSON/YAML text area, parse and load into builder or submit directly.

Two modes: Visual Builder (renders WorkflowBuilder) and JSON Import (textarea + file upload, parses JSON, validates name field, calls useCreateWorkflow()). Added lazy-loaded route in App.tsx before /workflows/:id to avoid conflict.
